culture-cycles.note: The patron-saint day is a school holiday in this state. The ministry lists it apart from the statutory public holidays, so do not assume shops or businesses close; the ministry page does not say.

laws.rule: Tyrol's stay levy (Aufenthaltsabgabe) is EUR 2.60 per person per night in accommodation (about A$4.13 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026), section 6(1) of the Tiroler Aufenthaltsabgabegesetz 2003. The state government can set up to EUR 5 for a tourism association's area by ordinance (section 6(2)), and may vary it by season and area. Stays by people up to the end of the year they turn 15 are exempt (section 4).
laws.heading: Tiroler Aufenthaltsabgabegesetz 2003, paragraphs 4 and 6

laws.rule: Tyrol: in public places children may not be out from 23:00 to 05:00, and young people up to the end of their 16th year not from 01:00 to 05:00, without a supervising person or an important reason (section 13 of the Tiroler Jugendgesetz). In pubs and similar premises under 16s may stay until 01:00 without a supervising person (section 16(2)).
laws.heading: Tiroler Jugendgesetz, sections 13 and 16

laws.rule: Tyrol: children and young people up to the end of the 16th year may not buy, have or drink alcohol. Spirits and mixed drinks with spirits are barred for all children and young people, and may not be given to anyone under 16 (section 18(2) to (4) of the Tiroler Jugendgesetz). The tobacco rule was not read.
laws.heading: Tiroler Jugendgesetz, section 18

laws.rule: Camping outside campsites is banned in Tyrol, except on land a council has opened up by regulation for a set period for a local need (section 3(1) and (6) of the Tiroler Campinggesetz 2001). Camping means staying overnight in a tent, caravan, motorhome or similar for tourism; a rest only to recover fitness to drive is not camping (section 2(a)). The law does not apply to a short stay in high alpine terrain (bivouac) (section 1(2)(b)). The authority can order the shelter removed (section 3(2)). The fine is up to EUR 600 (about A$953 at EUR 0.6293 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026; section 16(1)(a)).
laws.heading: Tiroler Campinggesetz 2001, sections 1, 2, 3, 16
